description: Source code implementing PPP protocol handling for a modem interface in Zephyr OS, including packet framing, state management, and API functions.

methods.name: modem_ppp_fcs_init
methods.description: Initializes FCS calculation with a byte.

methods.name: modem_ppp_fcs_update
methods.description: Updates FCS with a new byte.

methods.name: modem_ppp_ppp_protocol
methods.description: Determines PPP protocol based on packet family.

methods.name: modem_ppp_wrap_net_pkt_byte
methods.description: Wraps a network packet byte for transmission, handling framing and escaping.

methods.name: modem_ppp_process_received_byte
methods.description: Processes a received byte, handling framing, escaping, and packet assembly.

methods.name: modem_ppp_pipe_callback
methods.description: Callback for pipe events, triggers processing or sending work.

methods.name: modem_ppp_send_handler
methods.description: Handles sending of PPP frames, managing ring buffer and packet transmission.

methods.name: modem_ppp_process_handler
methods.description: Processes incoming data from pipe, assembling PPP frames.

methods.name: modem_ppp_ppp_api_init
methods.description: Initializes PPP API on network interface.

methods.name: modem_ppp_ppp_api_send
methods.description: Sends a network packet via PPP, with validation and queuing.

methods.name: modem_ppp_attach
methods.description: Attaches a pipe to PPP interface.

methods.name: modem_ppp_get_iface
methods.description: Returns network interface associated with PPP.

methods.name: modem_ppp_release
methods.description: Releases PPP interface and cleans up resources.

methods.name: modem_ppp_init_internal
methods.description: Initializes internal PPP state and buffers.
